definitions.gloss: time, years, the passage of time
definitions.explanation: A literary word for a long stretch of time that has passed. Carries a reflective, sometimes wistful tone about the flow of months and years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{歳月|さいげつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れた→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
{歳月|さいげつ}⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{薄|うす}れて→薄れる：14107_usureru⟧いく。
examples.english: Memories fade with the passage of time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{完成|かんせい}→完成：01550_kansei⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{歳月|さいげつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{多大|ただい}→多大：12181_tadai⟧な⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took many years and great expense to complete.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat literary word. More evocative and reflective than ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ or ⟦{年月|ねんげつ}→年月：00310_nengetsu⟧. Often used when looking back on a significant span of time or when emphasizing the weight of time passed. Common in written language, speeches, and narrative.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歳月|さいげつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧: time passes (poetic)
- {歳月|さいげつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}つ→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧: years go by
- ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{歳月|さいげつ}: many years, a long time
- {歳月|さいげつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to spend years on something

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{年月|ねんげつ}→年月：00310_nengetsu⟧: years and months (more neutral, less literary)
- ⟦{月日|つきひ}→月日：04063_tsukihi⟧: days and months, time (everyday, warm tone)
- {時|とき}: time (general, abstract)
